invariants.rationale: The method contract is to return a non-null List<WriteStatus>; null is unlikely.
The method logically expects preppedRecords to be non-null to perform bulk inserts.
instantTime represents a required commit time and is expected to be a non-empty string.
If preppedRecords is non-null, List.size() is always greater than or equal to zero.
A List's size() is always non-negative.
